sourceVisualNotes: This actual board contains FIVE inventory icons and ONE explicitly declared stand frame: top-right item3767 is stand frame0 from object/eye/eye125_stand.img,15x14 source crop/offset51,61, not an inventory icon. That item's inventory mapping and resource_id12 relation remain unverified. It visibly shows a red round ball with gold star, catalog calls it commemorative basketball. Do not claim we recovered its missing inventory image. Bottom-left3768 inventory has rainbow background around orange-white football; omit the background, keep the football.3017 is a paired white/lilac feather head ornament,3020 a silver ceremonial helm,3874 a butterfly and3875 a small red-flower/ivory-wrap bouquet.

items.name: ballet-crane-feather-pair
items.designBrief: One matched PAIR of small elegant ivory crane-feather hair ornaments, two curving tapered feather fans facing inward separated by transparent gap within their cell. Soft lilac shading, small gold/jade base fittings; no complete headband or wearer, no wings on a body.

items.name: celestial-ivory-war-helm
items.designBrief: A complete open silver-ivory war helmet with wide layered wing-like brow, many short upward blade-feather crown tips, a central upright top crest, long tapered cheek guards and gold/jade joints. Empty face hole, rounded carved Daoist clouds, ceremonial and distinct from plain gold zodiac helmets.

items.name: commemorative-red-basketball
items.sourceReferenceKind: explicit catalog-declared stand frame0; inventory mapping unresolved
items.designBrief: Our own original commemorative basketball interpretation: a complete plump RED leather basketball, curved dark-red seams, one small gold star/flower medallion and subtle cloud embossing. Source stand reference is a small red round ball, not an original recovered inventory map. No Olympic/logo/QQ face, no tassel, no ground shadow.

items.name: ivory-gold-commemorative-football
items.designBrief: A complete football with clear stitched white/ivory curved panels and orange-gold accent patches, jade/teal tiny cloud accents, original painted leather. Distinct from deep-teal regular football. No rainbow scene, pedestal, Olympic/brand marks or aura.

items.name: orchid-butterfly-hairband
items.designBrief: One vertical fluttering butterfly hair ornament with tall slim magenta/rose wings, warm orange-gold inner panels and small turquoise-blue accents, delicate antennae and a small jade clip underneath. Original fine natural butterfly veins, no framed card or wearer.

items.name: rose-ivory-bouquet
items.designBrief: A small compact bouquet with three pink-red roses, a few little ivory blossoms and jade leaves wrapped in folded ivory silk/paper tied with a short crimson ribbon. Slight diagonal tilt, complete wrapping tips, no hands or face.
